native_storage.static_accounting_scope: unchanged constructor preflight estimate; retained_capacity_v4 does not subtract it from runtime storage
native_storage.footprint_scope: owned Vec/String capacities, unique shared law/profile allocations and explicit allocator/map allowances; includes known dense clones, per-call binding, worker/profile and service-offer scratch; excludes Python frontend, opaque Rayon/allocator internals and unrelated caller-retained snapshots, which require the process limit
native_storage.allocation_rationale: road/journey values are non-additive ceilings on one shared dynamic pool; each phase subtracts other known live owners before allocation; capture/decode/validation have separate global admission; policy and total are checkpoint-bound, ephemeral quotas and worker counts are not
native_storage.scope: owner storage guards; total process address-space/RSS limit must cover caller-retained immutable snapshots and allocation overhead

execution_config.parallel_scope: independent indexed work above per-kernel size thresholds

report.activation: complete native preactivation; one shared occupied road

calendar.scope: exact compilation coverage; pages must enter one shared live runtime

assignment.scope: assignment, not trip completion; bus demand vehicles are occupancy equivalents

journey.carrier_sum_units: heterogeneous per-leg carrier units; not a physical total
journey.capacity_scope: dense_capacity_bytes excludes stage/history blocks; dynamic_storage_bytes counts persistent stage/history allocation estimates with shared prefixes counted per owner, not process RSS
